subject: Elastic capacity handoff and overrun pegging proposal
messages:
From: Anna Kim <anna.kim@scalegrid.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short-term capacity bump for 72-hr launch window

Hi Ben,

Quick note — we're expecting a hard launch spike on June 10 that will run heavy for ~72 hours. Forecast attached (scalegrid_traffic_forecast.csv). Can Redwood provide a temporary throughput uplift (roughly +40-60% of our committed quota) with a billing path that avoids punitive overrun charges?

Key asks:
- Temporary quota increase for 72 hours (with start/end times configurable)
- Clear pricing for the uplift and any overrun after the window
- Any available short-term discount or rebate tied to launch milestones
- PO timeline: we can get a PO within 48 hours once terms are agreed

Also, we'd like a written commitment that requests will not be throttled during the window (we'll be running product-critical traffic).

Can you outline options and a mutual action plan? If helpful, loop in finance/legal.

Thanks,
Anna Kim
Head of Engineering Ops
ScaleGrid

--
Attachment: scalegrid_traffic_forecast.csv (csv / 45KB)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kim <anna.kim@scalegrid.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term capacity bump for 72-hr launch window

Hi Anna — thanks for the forecast, looks like a clean spike. High level we can accommodate and keep you unthrottled. Below is an operationally simple option that balances cost predictability and customer protection.

Proposal (short-term uplift):
- Elastic handoff: +50% quota for a 7-day window (we recommend 7 days to give you buffer around the 72-hr peak).
- Pegged overrun rate: For the first 72 hours of the window, any overrun beyond the uplifted quota will be billed at your current committed unit rate (no punitive surge multiplier). After 72 hours, overrun reverts to standard overrun rates.
- Tiered launch rebate: if total token volume during the 7-day window exceeds your baseline by >=25%, we apply a launch rebate: 10% credit on incremental spend above baseline for the first 72 hours, 5% for the remainder of the 7 days.
- True-up cadence: monthly true-up with a final reconciliation invoice 30 days after the window.

Operational notes:
- PO required before the uplift start to lock capacity; we can provision on receipt of PO and signed addendum.
- Legal: addendum will be a 1-page SOW addendum + DocuSign.
- Attachments: proposed addendum draft attached (redwood_proposed_addendum.pdf).

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the pegged overrun and rebate structure.
2) We'll route the addendum to you via DocuSign and provision the uplift on PO receipt.

If you want a shorter window (exactly 72 hours) we can do that — pricing tweaks apply. Happy to hop on a 20-min call to finalize.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: scalegrid launch addendum - finance/legal note

Ben / Karthik — quick internal note on the proposed terms:

1) Rebate scope: Finance prefers to apply the tiered launch rebate to incremental spend within the uplifted quota only (not to punitive overrun charges). This reduces accounting complexity for the temporary window.
2) Peged overrun: Legal is comfortable with pegging the overrun rate to committed pricing for the first 72 hours but asks we add a short clause that the peg only applies if the account has no active billing disputes and the PO arrives before provisioning.
3) DocuSign: please request a PO + signed addendum prior to provisioning. We can provision on an interim basis (pre-provisioned warm pool) but billing will begin on uplift start.

If Ben wants to be more customer-friendly, we can agree to credit the first $X of overrun in rare edge cases, but that needs exec approval.

Action: Ben - draft a final email to Anna confirming rebate scope (incremental-within-uplift only), peg clause, and send DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

Subject: Final terms and DocuSign link — ScaleGrid launch window

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick responses and the launch calendar (attached). Confirming final terms below so there's no ambiguity: 

Final terms (summary):
- Uplift: +50% quota for a 7-day window (start date to be set by you during provisioning).
- Rebate: Tiered launch rebate applies only to incremental spend that falls within the uplifted quota (10% credit on incremental usage for first 72 hours when incremental >=25% over baseline; 5% thereafter during the 7-day window). Overrun charges billed outside the uplift will not be eligible for rebate.
- Peged overrun: For the first 72 hours of the window, any overrun will be billed at your current committed unit rate, provided we received a PO and there are no active billing disputes.
- True-up & invoicing: Monthly true-up; final reconciliation invoice issued 30 days after window close.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-123-ADDENDUM
(Attachment: scalegrid_launch_calendar.ics)

Please sign the addendum and confirm the exact uplift start time. Once DocuSign is complete and we have PO, we'll provision and confirm provisioning start time.

If you prefer a 72-hr-only window (starts exactly at the time you request) we can switch pricing to a 72-hr exact plan — let me know.

Congrats on the launch — happy we can support it.

Best,
